base_volumes.name: Base Volumes
base_volumes.description: Volumes a base application requires of every application extending it, in the same format as 'volumes'. Merged with the application's own volumes, which stay authoritative for the same key. Used by docker-compose to always mount the proxvex volume that holds the on-start hooks.

app_json_content.name: Application Config Overlay (app.json)
app_json_content.description: Optional base64-encoded app.json that overlays the auto-generated config.json with app-specific runtime values the deployer cannot derive.

app_slug.name: Application Slug
app_slug.description: Short lowercase slug used as database name (or schema prefix when sharing a DB), vhost-config filename, and Zitadel project label. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,30}$.

app_subdomain.name: Application Subdomain
app_subdomain.description: Fully qualified hostname the SPA is served on (e.g. products.example.com). Must be covered by the nginx wildcard cert.

app_tgz_content.name: Application Bundle (*.tgz)
app_tgz_content.description: Base64-encoded tgz produced by zitadel-pgrst-auth/examples/packaging/pack-for-proxvex.sh. Contains web/ and bootstrap/{bootstrap.sh,db/*.sql}. Scripts decode + tar -xzf inline at their execute_on target.

bearer_audience.name: Bearer Audience
bearer_audience.description: OAuth2 audience that issued JWTs must carry (aud claim). Use the application's hostname or a short slug. The addon registers an API application with this name in Zitadel.

bearer_audience_client_id.name: Bearer Audience Client ID
bearer_audience_client_id.description: clientId of the API application registered for bearer_audience. This is the actual aud claim value oauth2-proxy validates against. Populated by 172-conf-register-bearer-api.

bearer_audience_project_id.name: Bearer Audience Project ID
bearer_audience_project_id.description: Zitadel project ID hosting the bearer audience API app. Used for role grants when machine users need access. Populated by 172-conf-register-bearer-api.

bearer_listen_port.name: Bearer Listener Port
bearer_listen_port.description: External port the oauth2-proxy listens on. nginx and other consumers proxy_pass here.

bearer_upstream_port.name: Bearer Upstream Port
bearer_upstream_port.description: The application's internal HTTP port that oauth2-proxy forwards validated requests to. Defaults to the application's http_port.

vlan_tag.name: VLAN tag
vlan_tag.description: VLAN ID for the container's network interface on a VLAN-aware bridge (net0 tag=). Empty = untagged (native VLAN of the bridge).

compose_tag_overrides.name: Compose Image Tag Overrides
compose_tag_overrides.description: Comma-separated VAR=tag pairs (e.g. DOCKER_zitadel_TAG=v4.16.0) re-exported after the versions.sh library so docker-compose resolves these tags instead of the pins. Used by livetest -prev scenarios to install a real old version as an upgrade source.

db_anon_role.name: Anonymous DB Role
db_anon_role.description: PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE — PostgreSQL role for unauthenticated PostgREST requests. Must exist in the database (operator-created); see the Database setup section in the application docs.

db_login_role.name: DB Login Role (authenticator)
db_login_role.description: Authenticator role PostgREST connects as. Switches into per-app roles via SET ROLE. With addon-mtls, the client-cert CN must equal this value (PostgreSQL cert-hba auth).

db_migrations_table.name: DB Migrations Bookkeeping Table
db_migrations_table.description: Table (in the app's data schema) that tracks applied SQL migrations by filename + sha256. Read at install/upgrade to skip already-applied files.

db_schemas.name: Exposed DB Schemas
db_schemas.description: PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS — comma-separated list of PostgreSQL schemas PostgREST exposes.

debug_level.name: Debug Level
debug_level.description: Capture per-command debug bundle for this task. off = disabled. extLog = redacted script twin + variable annotations + interleaved backend logger trace. script = additionally injects 'set -x' into shell scripts.

docker_registry_mirror.name: Docker Hub Registry Mirror URL
docker_registry_mirror.description: Optional pull-through cache URL for Docker Hub (e.g. https://docker-registry-mirror). When set as a project default, post-start-dockerd.sh adds it to /etc/docker/daemon.json `registry-mirrors` so docker.io pulls from any docker-compose-based application go via the mirror instead of hitting Docker Hub directly. Empty disables the feature.

ghcr_registry_mirror.name: ghcr.io Registry Mirror URL
ghcr_registry_mirror.description: Optional pull-through cache URL for ghcr.io (e.g. https://zot-mirror). Docker has no per-registry mirror switch, so post-start-dockerd.sh installs an /etc/hosts redirect: ghcr.io -> the mirror's IP. The mirror's TLS cert must include 'DNS:ghcr.io' in its SAN — the proxvex zot-mirror app does this by default. Empty disables the feature.

app_external_url.name: External Base URL
app_external_url.description: Browser-facing base URL (scheme://host[:port]) of this application. Auto-derived by the deployer from addon-ssl (https/http), hostname and the app's port. Apps compose URLs like the OIDC redirect as {{app_external_url}}<app-specific-path>. Override via a parameter for reverse-proxy or public-domain setups.

DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_CLIENT_ID.name: Deployer OIDC Machine Client ID
DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of the deployer's machine-user in Zitadel. Used to mint a Bearer token via client_credentials grant for calls to the Zitadel Management API. Provided by the oidc stack output of the zitadel application's setup-deployer step.

DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_CLIENT_SECRET.name: Deployer OIDC Machine Client Secret
DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the deployer's machine-user. Paired with DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_CLIENT_ID for client_credentials grant. Stored in the oidc stack.

DEPLOYER_OIDC_ISSUER_URL.name: Deployer OIDC Issuer URL
DEPLOYER_OIDC_ISSUER_URL.description: Issuer URL of the Zitadel instance the deployer authenticates against (e.g. https://zitadel.example.com). Used as the OAuth token endpoint base.

DEPLOYER_OIDC_PROJECT_ID.name: Deployer OIDC Project ID
DEPLOYER_OIDC_PROJECT_ID.description: Zitadel project ID the deployer's machine-user belongs to. Used to request project-scoped tokens with role assertion.

endpoint_oidc_issuer.name: Endpoint OIDC Issuer
endpoint_oidc_issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL the runner-facing endpoint expects bearer tokens from. Empty when the endpoint does not require OIDC. Emitted by 351-post-emit-endpoint-config so the livetest runner can mint tokens for subsequent CLI calls.

endpoint_requires_oidc.name: Endpoint Requires OIDC
endpoint_requires_oidc.description: "true" if the deployer endpoint requires a Bearer JWT on every request (post-self-reconfigure-enable-https-oidc state); "false" otherwise. Emitted by 351-post-emit-endpoint-config so the livetest runner can switch auth mode without probing.

endpoint_url.name: Endpoint URL
endpoint_url.description: Full external URL the runner should use to reach the deployer after this scenario. Recomputed from /etc/pve/lxc/<vm_id>.conf truth (SSL mountpoint + OIDC_ENABLED env). Emitted by 351-post-emit-endpoint-config; the livetest runner delta-detects against its current apiUrl and updates only on change.

extra_envs.name: Extra Environment Variables
extra_envs.description: Newline-separated KEY=value overlay merged on top of `envs` (overlay keys override/extend the base block; same format and `{{ }}` templating as `envs`). CLI/production-only channel to override individual env vars without restating the whole `envs` string — the frontend edits `envs` directly, so this is `internal`. Applied at install/reconfigure by conf-oci-lxc-configuration.py; empty by default.

mirror_mode.name: Registry Mirror Mode
mirror_mode.description: Operating mode for distribution-based registry mirror containers. proxy: pull-through cache (recommended). readwrite: private push-target registry (Distribution's 7-day TTL scheduler erodes pull-through caches — avoid). readonly: frozen corpus. Set as a locked value in docker-registry-mirror/application.json.

mtls_cns.name: Client Certificate CNs
mtls_cns.description: One Common Name per line. Each gets a CA-signed client certificate written to the mtls/<CN>/ subdir of the app's certs volume.

oidc_redirect_uri.name: OIDC Redirect URI
oidc_redirect_uri.description: Full OIDC redirect/callback URL the application sends to Zitadel and that Zitadel registers as the only valid redirectUri for this client. Apps inherit a default from oci-image (https://{{hostname}}{{project_domain_suffix}}/api/auth/callback) and can override per app.

oidc_post_logout_uri.name: OIDC Post-Logout URI
oidc_post_logout_uri.description: Full OIDC post-logout URL the application uses after sign-out and that Zitadel registers as the only valid postLogoutRedirectUri. Optional — when omitted, the OIDC app is created without a post-logout redirect, which is preferable when the landing page is itself OIDC-protected (Zitadel would otherwise loop the user back into the auth flow on logout).

packagerpubkeyurl.name: URL of the public key for verifying the package

permission_fix_paths.name: Paths to fix permissions for after pct create + idmap
permission_fix_paths.description: Space-separated list of paths inside the LXC rootfs to walk after pct create + idmap setup. For each path, files already owned by the container's uid/gid are re-chowned to the host-side mapped_uid:mapped_gid. Default '/' covers the whole rootfs; files owned by other users (root, system uids) stay untouched. Apps that only need a narrow fix (e.g. wolproxy: '/home/wolproxy /app') can override this property.

pg_client_cert.name: PostgreSQL Client Certificate Auth (mTLS)
pg_client_cert.description: When true (and addon-ssl is active), PostgreSQL requires a CA-signed client certificate for all TCP connections (managed pg_hba.conf with 'hostssl ... cert'). The CA public certificate is written to /certs/chain.pem and referenced via ssl_ca_file. Unix-socket connections keep 'local all all trust' so the container's own initdb/admin tasks keep working. Password-only TCP clients must migrate to addon-mtls client certs. Toggling off fully reverts to password auth.

pg_hba_content.name: PostgreSQL pg_hba.conf
pg_hba_content.description: Base64 of the rendered pg_hba.conf (from file:pg_hba.conf.tmpl). Only applied when pg_client_cert=true; written verbatim to <pgdata>/pg_hba.conf, replacing the managed default. Supply custom content for cert+password (clientcert=verify-ca / verify-full) or mixed policies.

pgrst_jwks_url.name: PostgREST JWKS URL
pgrst_jwks_url.description: JWKS endpoint of the OIDC provider (e.g. Zitadel). Fetched once at install/reconfigure into the jwks volume because PostgREST cannot poll URLs itself. Default derived from ZITADEL_HOST + project_domain_suffix.

pgrst_jwt_secret.name: PostgREST JWT Secret
pgrst_jwt_secret.description: PGRST_JWT_SECRET — JWKS file path (@/path/jwks.json), URL (PostgREST >=12), or inline JWK literal. Empty disables JWT validation (PostgREST runs anonymous-only). For zitadel-pgrst-auth setups, set to @/etc/postgrest/jwks/jwks.json after the jwks volume is populated by conf-fetch-jwks.

pgrst_pre_request.name: PostgREST DB Pre-Request
pgrst_pre_request.description: PGRST_DB_PRE_REQUEST — schema-qualified function run before every query (e.g. auth.ensure_principal for JIT principal mirror). Empty disables. Set on the postgrest application when wired up to a zitadel-pgrst-auth-style auth schema.

seed_demo_data.name: Seed Demo Data
seed_demo_data.description: When true, runs bootstrap.sh from the uploaded tgz to create Zitadel demo orgs/users + seed demo data. NOT for production — requires upstream bootstrap.sh patches that gate instance-feature mutations behind a flag. Demo password is the bootstrap.sh env default, not a proxvex parameter.

ZITADEL_MASTERKEY.name: ZITADEL_MASTERKEY
ZITADEL_MASTERKEY.description: Zitadel encryption masterkey (32 chars) from the oidc stack. Written by conf-write-zitadel-yaml to the `config` volume as the plain `masterkey` file and passed via the static `--masterkeyFile` flag (Zitadel ignores the env/config-key forms under start-from-init).

NGINX_HOST.name: NGINX_HOST
NGINX_HOST.description: Hostname of the nginx dependency container (resolved by 185-host-resolve-dependency-hosts).

POSTGRES_HOST.name: POSTGRES_HOST
POSTGRES_HOST.description: Hostname of the postgres dependency container (resolved by 185-host-resolve-dependency-hosts).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres superuser password (provided by postgres stack).

POSTGREST_HOST.name: POSTGREST_HOST
POSTGREST_HOST.description: Hostname of the postgrest container (published by the postgrest stack provider).

POSTGREST_PORT.name: POSTGREST_PORT
POSTGREST_PORT.description: PostgREST listen port (published by the postgrest stack provider, default 3000).

POSTGREST_URL.name: POSTGREST_URL
POSTGREST_URL.description: Full internal URL to PostgREST (published by the postgrest stack provider).

PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS.name: PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS
PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS.description: Comma-separated list of schemas PostgREST currently exposes (published by the postgrest stack provider).

ZITADEL_PORT.name: Zitadel Port
ZITADEL_PORT.description: Zitadel API port (provided by oidc stack).

ZITADEL_PROTO.name: Zitadel Protocol
ZITADEL_PROTO.description: Protocol for Zitadel API: http or https (provided by oidc stack).

ZITADEL_URL.name: Zitadel Base URL
ZITADEL_URL.description: Composed Zitadel base URL (proto://host:port). Provided by the oidc stack and consumed by the jwks-refresh on-start template (341-post-install-jwks-refresh-on-start) to fetch the OIDC JWKS endpoint.

ZITADEL_SSL_PORT.name: Zitadel SSL Port
ZITADEL_SSL_PORT.description: HTTPS port of the Zitadel container when addon-ssl is active (provided by oidc stack).

ZITADEL_SSL_PROTO.name: Zitadel SSL Protocol
ZITADEL_SSL_PROTO.description: HTTPS protocol marker for Zitadel API (provided by oidc stack when addon-ssl is active).

zitadel_yaml_content.name: ZITADEL Base Config (zitadel.yaml)
zitadel_yaml_content.description: Base64 of the rendered zitadel.yaml (from file:zitadel.yaml.tmpl). Written to the `config` managed volume pre-start and loaded by Zitadel via --config. Holds external domain/port, database connection, login/OIDC/SAML URLs, and the top-level Masterkey (Zitadel ignores ZITADEL_MASTERKEY env under start-from-init --config). DB passwords stay as compose env vars (normal viper keys) for stack rotation.

zitadel_smtp_yaml_content.name: ZITADEL SMTP Overlay (zitadel.smtp.yaml)
zitadel_smtp_yaml_content.description: Base64 of the rendered zitadel.smtp.yaml (from file:zitadel.smtp.yaml.tmpl). Loaded as an additional --config. Written verbatim only when SMTP_PASSWORD is set; otherwise conf-write-zitadel-yaml.sh writes a comment-only file so the static --config reference resolves but contributes no SMTPConfiguration (Zitadel rejects partial/blank SMTP).

zitadel_init_yaml_content.name: ZITADEL FirstInstance Config (zitadel.init.yaml)
zitadel_init_yaml_content.description: Base64 of the rendered zitadel.init.yaml (from file:zitadel.init.yaml.tmpl). FirstInstance bootstrap config (admin user, machine users, PAT paths) loaded as an additional --config only during initial bootstrap. The post-bootstrap hardening step deletes this file and drops its --config so the non-idempotent FirstInstance migration never re-runs.

zot_config.name: Zot Config (config.json)
zot_config.description: Full zot daemon config, written verbatim to /etc/zot/config.json before container start. The default proxies ghcr.io with on-demand sync. Edit to add upstreams (e.g. registry-1.docker.io for Phase B) — the cert SAN already covers DNS:ghcr.io,DNS:registry-1.docker.io,DNS:index.docker.io.
